q: A capacitor is used as an electric circuit component to store _____.
e: A capacitor is used as an electric circuit component to store electrical energy. Put mechanical energy or thermal energy in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Electrical energy is what a current carries through a circuit, later turned into heat, light or motion. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: The capacitor was originally known as a _____.
e: The capacitor was originally known as a condenser. resistor is not condenser, and inductor is not condenser either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Condenser is the old name; the modern word is capacitor.

q: A capacitor is an electrical device that stores electrical energy in the form of an _____.
e: A capacitor is an electrical device that stores electrical energy in the form of an electric field. magnetic field is not electric field, and gravitational field is not electric field either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Electrical energy is what a current carries through a circuit, later turned into heat, light or motion.

q: A capacitor consists of two conductors separated by a _____.
e: A capacitor consists of two conductors separated by a small distance. Put large distance or metallic wire in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A conductor lets charge drift when a potential difference is applied across it. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: An _____ is inserted between the conductors of a capacitor.
e: An insulator is inserted between the conductors of a capacitor. conductor is not insulator, and semiconductor is not insulator either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Film capacitors are the ones that use _____ as the dielectric medium.
e: Film capacitors are the ones that use plastic film as the dielectric medium. ceramic is not plastic film, and oxide layer is not plastic film either. A dielectric polarizes between the plates, raising C and the voltage the gap can stand.

q: Film capacitors are available in working voltages up to _____.
e: Film capacitors are available in working voltages up to 1500 V. Put 500 V or 100 V in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points.

q: Ceramic capacitors are the ones that use _____ as the dielectric material.
e: Ceramic capacitors are the ones that use ceramic as the dielectric material. Put plastic film or air in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A dielectric polarizes between the plates, raising C and the voltage the gap can stand. Ceramic capacitors use a ceramic layer as the dielectric and stay compact on a board.

q: Ceramic capacitors are mainly used for high stability performances with _____.
e: Ceramic capacitors are mainly used for high stability performances with low losses. high losses is not low losses, and moderate losses is not low losses either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Ceramic capacitors use a ceramic layer as the dielectric and stay compact on a board.

q: The capacitance values of ceramic capacitors are stable with respect to the applied voltage, frequency, and _____.
e: The capacitance values of ceramic capacitors are stable with respect to the applied voltage, frequency, and temperature. pressure is not temperature, and humidity is not temperature either. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points. Ceramic capacitors use a ceramic layer as the dielectric and stay compact on a board.

q: Electrolytic capacitors are the ones that use the _____ as the dielectric material.
e: Electrolytic capacitors are the ones that use the oxide layer as the dielectric material. plastic film and ceramic belong to other processes, not this oxide layer case. A dielectric polarizes between the plates, raising C and the voltage the gap can stand. Electrolytics use an oxide film, pack large C, and the polarity mark must be respected.

q: There are mainly two types of electrolytic capacitors; tantalum and _____.
e: There are mainly two types of electrolytic capacitors; tantalum and aluminum. mica and paper belong to other processes, not this aluminum case. Electrolytics use an oxide film, pack large C, and the polarity mark must be respected.

q: Electrolytic capacitors are available with working voltages of up to approximately _____.
e: Electrolytic capacitors are available with working voltages of up to approximately 500 V. 1500 V is not 500 V, and 2000 V is not 500 V either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points.

q: The failure of electrolytic capacitors can be hazardous, resulting in an _____.
e: The failure of electrolytic capacitors can be hazardous, resulting in an explosion or fire. Put open circuit or short circuit in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Electrolytics use an oxide film, pack large C, and the polarity mark must be respected.

q: Variable capacitors mostly use _____ as the dielectric medium.
e: Variable capacitors mostly use air as the dielectric medium. plastic film is not air, and ceramic is not air either. A dielectric polarizes between the plates, raising C and the voltage the gap can stand. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: The capacitance of a variable capacitor can be _____ adjusted.
e: The capacitance of a variable capacitor can be mechanically adjusted. Put thermally or chemically in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Variable capacitors are used to set the _____ frequency in tuner devices.
e: Variable capacitors are used to set the cutoff frequency in tuner devices. resonance is not cutoff, and modulation is not cutoff either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: A supercapacitor (SC), is also called an _____.
e: A supercapacitor (SC), is also called an ultracapacitor. inductor is not ultracapacitor, and resistor is not ultracapacitor either. An ultracapacitor packs huge C into a small volume for rapid charge and discharge.

q: A supercapacitor bridges the gap between electrolytic capacitors and _____.
e: A supercapacitor bridges the gap between electrolytic capacitors and rechargeable batteries. resistors is not rechargeable batteries, and inductors is not rechargeable batteries either. An ultracapacitor packs huge C into a small volume for rapid charge and discharge.

q: A supercapacitor typically stores _____ times more energy than electrolytic capacitors.
e: A supercapacitor typically stores 10 to 100 times more energy than electrolytic capacitors. Put 2 to 5 or 1000 to 5000 in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Smaller supercapacitor units are used as power backup for static random-access memory (_____).
e: Smaller supercapacitor units are used as power backup for static random-access memory (SRAM). Put DRAM or ROM in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. An ultracapacitor packs huge C into a small volume for rapid charge and discharge.

q: Film capacitors and ceramic capacitors are _____ capacitors.
e: Film capacitors and ceramic capacitors are non-polarized capacitors. polarized is not non-polarized, and variable is not non-polarized either. Ceramic capacitors use a ceramic layer as the dielectric and stay compact on a board. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Non-polarized capacitors mean that they do not have _____.
e: Non-polarized capacitors mean that they do not have polarities. dielectrics is not polarities, and plates is not polarities either. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Capacitors are used for blocking DC current after getting fully charged but allow the _____ current to pass through it.
e: Capacitors are used for blocking DC current after getting fully charged but allow the AC current to pass through it. Put static or magnetic in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

q: Capacitors are used to eliminate sparking in automobile _____ systems.
e: Capacitors are used to eliminate sparking in automobile ignition systems. Put cooling or braking in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Capacitors can be used as the sensor for measuring humidity, fuel levels, and _____.
e: Capacitors can be used as the sensor for measuring humidity, fuel levels, and temperature. Put mechanical strain or light in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A sensor gives a measurable electrical response when a physical condition changes.

q: A timing capacitor is likely used in any flashing light or regular _____ system.
e: A timing capacitor is likely used in any flashing light or regular beeping system. Put heating or cooling in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Electrolytic capacitors are used for filtering and smoothing rectified _____ voltage.
e: Electrolytic capacitors are used for filtering and smoothing rectified alternating voltage. Put direct or static in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Electrolytics use an oxide film, pack large C, and the polarity mark must be respected. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: Variable capacitors are mostly used in AC circuits especially for high frequency, high power and _____.
e: Variable capacitors are mostly used in AC circuits especially for high frequency, high power and low loss. high loss is not low loss, and zero loss is not low loss either. AC reverses on a clock; household supply is this reversing current.

q: Supercapacitors are used in applications requiring many rapid _____ cycles.
e: Supercapacitors are used in applications requiring many rapid magnetizing/demagnetizing cycles. charge/discharge is not magnetizing/demagnetizing, and heating/cooling is not magnetizing/demagnetizing either. An ultracapacitor packs huge C into a small volume for rapid charge and discharge.
